en: Multiview color postcard with an orange border showing Romania's Black Sea resort area: a tall modern seaside hotel and grounds (Neptun), a large sanatorium complex (Techirghiol), and a lakeside promenade at Lake Techirghiol. The reverse is in Romanian with the POSTA ROMANA crest, a 40‑bani Romanian stamp, a Bucharest address written by hand, and a short handwritten message.
